messages.subject: Maximum supported R version is: 3.1.1 Execution halted
parts:
Hi,

I'm getting the following error when trying to deploy my shiny app ->

If your application fails to run post-deployment, please double-check these messages.
Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application: 20852...
Waiting for task: 2654354
  building: Processing bundle: 73477
  error: Parsing manifest
################################## Begin Log ################################## 
################################### End Log ################################### 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 2654355 failed: Error parsing manifest: Maximum supported R version is: 3.1.1
Execution halted

What should I do?

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Maximum supported R version is: 3.1.1 Execution halted
parts:
We have not added support for R 3.1.2 to ShinyApps yet. We will likely add it tonight or tomorrow. In the meantime, my suggestion would be to install R 3.1.1 as it is the maximum supported version.

-Andy
